professionalSummary: Experienced Project Manager with over six years in financial services, specializing in regulatory change initiatives across policy administration, claims, and finance systems.
Certified PRINCE2 Practitioner with current registration, adept at leading projects that implement new conduct and reporting rules.
Skilled in maintaining comprehensive project plans and RAID logs, reporting progress to steering committees, and coordinating user acceptance testing with business stakeholders.
experienceHighlights: Project Manager, Ashgrove Mutual Insurance (May 2022 – Aug 2026): led the pricing‑practices remediation project, updated renewal‑pricing logic in the policy administration system, maintained plan and RAID log, and secured test sign‑off from the pricing team.
Presented monthly status packs to the change steering committee, detailing milestones, budget performance, and escalations requiring committee decisions.
Project Manager, Linnet Life & Pensions (Jun 2020 – Apr 2022): delivered redesign of annual statements for pension customers and transitioned policy document printing to a new supplier.
Project Coordinator, Linnet Life & Pensions (Oct 2019 – May 2020): managed minutes and action log for IT service desk migration.
projectsAndWorkSamples: An anonymised RAID log and milestone plan from the pricing‑practices remediation project, illustrating owners, due dates, dependencies on the policy administration release, and steering committee decisions on escalated risks.

keeping the plan and RAID log in the PMO tool and collecting test sign-off from the pricing team.
